app_cms.set_meal_slots validates HH:MM 24-hr with regex, enforces admin/staff RBAC (403 for other roles) — LGTM.

app_cms.collect_takeaway now atomically marks pendency collected, decrements user.tiffin_balance, AND calls increment_stock_db (source=takeaway_collected). Any exception from stock helper is caught & logged — resilient design.
rider.rider_deliver: takeaway returnable-tiffin block now inserts pendency AND calls decrement_stock_db (source=takeaway_delivered) with the customer's mess_id — correct branch scoping.
tiffin_stock.increment_stock_db uses find_one_and_update $inc atomically + logs a 'return' movement row with delta=+n after=new_qty — mirrors decrement path. LGTM.
AdminKiosk.jsx activeSlot useMemo returns 'off' when outside both windows (both tabs disable); a 60s setInterval bumps setSlotTick which re-evaluates useMemo — correctly re-checks slot boundary.
KioskCounterPanel disables buttons via disabled attr AND applies visual faded class (bg-white/8 text-white/40 cursor-not-allowed) when its slot is inactive — verified in DOM.

KioskMenuCard: gold-diamond separator has been removed; LUNCH+DINNER tiles are wrapped in a single grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 — matches restaurant TodayMessMenuFlash mobile layout. Item lists use flex flex-col gap-0.5.
index.css .kiosk-lights-shell with ::before/::after radial-gradient bulb patterns + kioskLightsTwinkle keyframes 1.6s ease-in-out alternate — verified via getComputedStyle.
